01-ancestors.how: follow 'in' lists in indexes/node-locator (binary edges + hyperedge premise->conclusion) transitively

03-unresolved-prerequisites.how: premises of each hyperedge whose node math_status is not ESTABLISHED (no node is ESTABLISHED in this snapshot)

04-counterexamples.how: retractions (target_seq), negative nodes, refuted validations, RETRACTS edges

07-transformations.how: KEYWORD_SELECTION; source/target/preconditions are NOT stored as typed fields in the graph

08-cross-campaign.how: edges whose endpoints carry different session/question ids

09-unconnected-results.how: result-type nodes with no outgoing edge and no non-PART_OF incoming edge; review_evidence keeps graph flags, proofbook-text claims and review records separate

10-multiply-supported-conjectures.how: >= 2 distinct sessions/questions among SUPPORTED_BY / DERIVED_FROM neighbours (observational, not proof)

11-circular-dependencies.how: strongly connected components (size>1 or self-loop) of DERIVED_FROM/SUPPORTED_BY/RETRACTS/... + hyperedges; organizational edges included, so cycles are structural, not necessarily logical

12-closed-not-reused.how: obligations with a closing_node_id whose closing node has no outgoing edge (none are status CLOSED in this snapshot)
